summary: Comprehensive testing of Full Notification System (Iteration 40). All 10 features VERIFIED: Backend API (5/5 endpoints pass), Frontend UI (5/5 features pass). The notification system correctly handles admin notifications, client notifications, notification creation on events (orders, status changes), and navigation on click.

passed_tests.backend_feature_1: ✓ PASS: GET /api/admin/notifications returns admin-specific notifications with user_id=ADMIN - returns {notifications, unread_count, total}
passed_tests.backend_feature_2: ✓ PASS: PUT /api/admin/notifications/{id}/read marks specific admin notification as read - returns {message: 'Notification marked as read'}
passed_tests.backend_feature_3: ✓ PASS: POST /api/admin/notifications/mark-read marks all admin notifications as read - returns {message: 'Notifications marked as read'}
passed_tests.backend_feature_4: ✓ PASS: POST /api/orders creates order AND admin receives 'new_order' notification with link=/admin/orders
passed_tests.backend_feature_5: ✓ PASS: PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status changes status AND client receives notification with type='order' and link='/orders'
passed_tests.frontend_feature_6: ✓ PASS: Client NotificationsPage (/notifications) renders with correct icons and labels (order, chat, news, balance, order_change)
passed_tests.frontend_feature_7: ✓ PASS: Clicking notification marks it as read and navigates to the linked page (tested admin notification -> /admin/orders)
passed_tests.frontend_feature_8: ✓ PASS: AdminNotificationsPage (/admin/notifications) renders correctly for admin users with header 'УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ'
passed_tests.frontend_feature_9: ✓ PASS: AdminNotificationsPage shows 'Прочитать все' button when there are unread notifications (visible with 2 unread)
passed_tests.frontend_feature_10: ✓ PASS: Admin bell dropdown (AdminNotifications component) shows 'Все уведомления' link to /admin/notifications

critical_code_review_comments: notify.py: Centralized notification functions (notify_user, notify_admin, notify_all_users) correctly store notifications in MongoDB with user_id='ADMIN' for admin notifications
admin.py lines 417-459: Admin notification endpoints properly filter by user_id='ADMIN' and include backward compat for old activities collection
orders.py line 249: Order creation correctly calls notify_admin() with type='new_order' and link='/admin/orders'
orders.py lines 383-389: Status change via PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status calls create_notification() for client
NotificationsPage.js: TYPE_CONFIG correctly maps notification types to icons (Package for order, MessageCircle for chat, Megaphone for news, Wallet for balance)
AdminNotificationsPage.js: Uses authLoading to prevent redirect during auth initialization - good UX pattern
AdminNotifications.js line 130: 'Все уведомления' link correctly navigates to /admin/notifications

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 5 UI features verified via Playwright

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full notification system complete. Admin notifications use user_id='ADMIN' in notifications collection. Client notifications use actual user_id. Notification types: new_order (admin), order (client status), chat (both), news (all users), registration (admin), order_accepted/order_cancelled (admin). Both pages poll every 3s. Sound notifications use Web Audio API. Push notifications via Notification API when tab unfocused.
